series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: Guyana's INDC has outlined policies, measures and actions, both conditional and unconditional that the country commits to implement up to 2025, in the energy and forestry sector. "The major overarching contribution that Guyana intends to make is to pursue a path to a Green economy using a low emission strategy pathway. Guyana has already formulated a LCDS and with limited financial resources, has begun implementation. With additional and adequate resources, Guyana can build on this and embark on a comprehensive path to a low emission and green economy." "More specifically, with the provision of adequate resources, Guyana can provide up to 52Mt CO 2 equivalent to global mitigation effort, and can increase its share of renewable energy by 20 percent of its total energy usage, by 2025." The INDC also include annex on Adaptation.
ndc_assessment.sectors: Forestry and Energy, and also includes the following notes on agriculture sector
ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2026-07-01. 61 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (15). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 21.8 MtCO₂e, DS-35 13.4 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 45.9 for 2024. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.16°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.57°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
